scoring.rule: pass if abs(actual - expected) <= max(absolute_floor, relative_epsilon * abs(expected)); strings compared case-insensitively after trimming

story: OrderDate is uniformly DD/MM/YYYY. A naive month-first parse silently drops 5,952 rows, so 2018 Q3 sales reads $50,517.26 instead of the correct $143,787.36.
baseline_fairness: Vera's model only ever sees the schema profile plus sample rows — never the 2.3 MB file. The no-execution baseline gets identical context and is simply not allowed to run code. Same prompt, one executes.
